# Ajeem Suban

Site name: The Ajeem Times (a newspaper-style portfolio).

> Ajeem Suban (also written AJEEM.S) is an AI Engineer & Developer from
> Tamil Nadu, India. He builds Tamil-first AI end to end (data, models, API,
> UI). His first and main project is TAMIL-AI.ME, a tool to search and
> understand Tamil classical literature in Tamil and English.

## Identity

- Name: Ajeem Suban (alternate: AJEEM.S)
- Role: AI Engineer & Developer
- Education: 3rd-year B.Tech, Artificial Intelligence & Data Science,
  Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan University (DSU), Perambalur, Tamil Nadu
  (batch 2024-2028)
- From: Kallakurichi district, Tamil Nadu

## Projects

- [TAMIL-AI.ME](https://github.com/ajeem-suban/Project-TAMIL-AI.ME) - In progress.
  Search and explanation for Tamil classical literature. FastAPI, ChromaDB,
  React, IndicTrans2 translation, multilingual-e5 embeddings. 4,500+ entries
  across 22 sources indexed. Includes KalVettu, an OCR sub-module that
  currently reads printed Tamil documents only (not stone inscriptions yet).
- [AIRES](https://github.com/ajeem-suban/AIRES-AI) - MVP built.
  AI emergency-response MVP with live ambulance re-routing on a real Trichy
  road map. Simulation result: across 300 simulated runs, trip time fell from
  7.77 to 5.86 minutes. [Live demo](https://aires-demo-eight.vercel.app/).
- [SECRAIN](https://github.com/ajeem-suban/SECRAIN) - Active development.
  Local-first "second brain": FastAPI, SQLite, ChromaDB, Ollama (Qwen3).
  Phase 1 complete.
- [CULLINAN AI](https://github.com/ajeem-suban/cullinan-ai) - Active
  development. Personalised image generation that preserves a person's facial
  identity. Built so far: a face recognition and verification pipeline
  (InsightFace, ArcFace; 69 reference images, 512-dimensional embeddings;
  10/10 genuine accepted and 7/7 impostors rejected on the author's own
  evaluation set, 6/6 unit tests passed) and a Stable Diffusion 1.5 + Kohya_ss
  setup for identity-specific LoRA training. The image generator itself is not
  finished yet.
- [TITAN](https://github.com/ajeem-suban/TITAN-ASSISTANT) - In progress.
  Desktop workspace UI with a "Hey TITAN" voice pipeline, built on SECRAIN.
  Voice still uses Groq's cloud.
- [Eye-Care-Tool](https://github.com/ajeem-suban/Eye-Care-Tool) - v1.0.0,
  Windows .exe shipped. 20-20-20 eye-break reminder that checks real activity,
  with webcam fatigue detection. Research on the 20-20-20 rule is mixed.
- [VCH-AGENT](https://github.com/ajeem-suban/VCH-AGENT) - In progress. Predicts
  which Reddit/YouTube content will go viral within about 72 hours. No results yet.
- [news-bot](https://github.com/ajeem-suban/news-bot) - Running. Telegram news
  digest across 7 RSS categories, Gemini 2.5 Flash, GitHub Actions.
- [ROGERS](https://github.com/ajeem-suban/ROGERS) - In development. AI Student
  Project Orchestrator: aims to turn a simple project idea into a structured
  software workflow using specialised AI agents (research, architecture,
  backend, frontend, testing, debugging), with free, paid and local model
  support and human approval at each step. Python, React, FastAPI, SQLite, Ollama.
